name: ielts-writing-agent
title_zh: 雅思小作文先给分再讲评的考官型批改员
tagline_zh: 交一篇 Task 1 作文，它按考官标准打分、逐条诊断、给 Band 9 范文和双语讲解，还附题型写作指南。
tagline_en: Submit your Task 1 essay, get strict band scores, problem diagnosis, Band 9 model answer, and bilingual.
desc_en: IELTS Academic Task 1 writing coach and examiner workflow. Use when the user asks to mark, score, polish, explain, teach, or export an IELTS Academic Task 1 essay from a prompt, chart image, or student response, especially for study-abroad IELTS preparation. Produces strict scoring, problem diagnosis, Band 9 model answer, bilingual model explanation, task-type writing guide, vocabulary/sentence st
why_zh: 不是泛泛润色，而是先按四项评分标准严格打分，再逐项拆解问题，最后给范文和讲解，闭环完整。
why_en: It doesn't just polish. It scores against official criteria, pinpoints weaknesses, then provides a model answer and teaching.
limit_zh: 只认雅思学术类 Task 1（图表题），不处理 Task 2 议论文；需要输入图表描述或学生作文，否则无法启动。
limit_en: Only for IELTS Academic Task 1 (charts/graphs). Needs a prompt, chart image, or student essay. Output ends at model answer and guide; no follow-up.
title_en: IELTS Task 1 Essay Examiner: Score, Diagnose, and Teach
